title: dryopteris microbasis
intro: Dryopteris microbasis, commonly known as the microbasis wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus and is native to certain regions of the world. The microbasis wood fern is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris microbasis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
